name: Random
description: Random numbers, weighted name draws, shuffling, team splitting, dice and coins, with verifiable seeds
help: Numbers: generate one or more integers in a range, optionally unique and sorted.
List: one name per line. A draw picks each name at most once; with Weighted on, write “Name*3” to give that name three times the chance. Groups differ in size by at most one.
By default the operating system's secure random source is used, so every result is different.

With a seed the result is reproducible: the same seed, list and options always give the same outcome. Announce the seed before drawing (for example today's date or a match score) and anyone can check the result afterwards, proving it was not cherry-picked.
Seeded mode uses ChaCha20 keyed with SHA-256; the algorithm is versioned so future releases reproduce today's results.
